title: Planning an E-Cigarette Collection Point: Questions Retailers Should Ask in 2026
searchIntent: Give adult retail readers a high-level pre-planning framework for an e-cigarette collection program, based on EPA public guidance, without turning the article into hazardous-waste handling instructions.
sourceName: U.S. EPA — Safely Collecting and Managing E-Cigarettes from Households
sourceFacts: EPA's 2026 tip sheet is intended for businesses such as vape shops interested in collecting unwanted nicotine e-cigarettes from households.
EPA describes coordinating with a household hazardous waste facility or contracting with a hazardous waste transporter before beginning collection.
EPA emphasizes that state and local requirements can differ.
jurisdictionBoundary: Discuss the EPA resource as US guidance only. Refer readers to local environmental, health or solid-waste agencies for operative requirements.
prohibitedClaims: Do not give detailed instructions for dismantling devices or transporting hazardous waste.
Do not say a collection point is legally compliant without local confirmation.
